children: (the “Company”) (Euronext Growth: ALCLS - NASDAQ: CLLS), a clinical-stage biotechnology company using its pioneering gene editing platform to develop life-saving cell and gene therapies, today announced that it will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, September 14, 2026 to provide a business update.
A replay will be available on the Company’s website following the event.

Cellectis is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using its pioneering gene-editing platform to develop life-saving cell and gene therapies. The company utilizes an allogeneic approach for CAR T immunotherapies in oncology, pioneering the concept of off-the-shelf and ready-to-use gene-edited CAR T-cells to treat cancer patients, and a platform to develop gene therapies in other therapeutic indications. With its in-house manufacturing capabilities, Cellectis is one of the few end-to-end gene editing companies that controls the cell and gene therapy value chain from start to finish. Cellectis’ headquarters are in Paris, France, with locations in New York and Raleigh, NC. Cellectis is listed on the Nasdaq Global Market
. To find out more, visit www.cellectis.com and follow Cellectis on LinkedIn and X.
For further information on Cellectis, please contact:
Patricia Sosa Navarro, Chief of Staff to the CEO, +33 (0)7 76 77 46 93, media@cellectis.com
Arthur Stril, Chief Financial Officer & Chief Business Officer, investors@cellectis.com

title: Cellectis to Host Conference Call and Webcast on September 14 to Provide a Business Update
